text: Dr. Julie Lamb billed 3 claims after credential CRD_000996 was revoked on 2026-01-11, starting 38 days after revocation. Three claims is at the bottom of the post-revocation range and consistent with treatment courses that were already underway when the licence lapsed. The alert exists because the revocation is recent and the billing is current, which is worth a look but not an escalation on its own. An innocent completion-of-care reading fits the numbers at least as well as misconduct. Next step: check whether the three claims belong to patients whose treatment began before 2026-01-11; if so, dismiss.
